desc: Read N, S, T; build list of differing positions.
Create a set of source letters and an adjacency list for each source letter (guaranteed at most one target per source).
Implement DFS cycle detection on 26 lowercase letters; if a cycle (including self-loop to different letter, which won't exist here) is found, print -1.
If no cycle, print the size of the source set as the minimum number of operations.

Implement the full solution: consistency check (each source maps to at most one target), feasibility check (no target with out>0 and in==0), build components, sum cost = (nodes-1) for trees and (nodes+1) for cycles, and output total.
Test on all four sample cases and additional edge cases (e.g., single letters, direct swaps, cycle with attached tree).
